about: The job's remainder at 360x640 (the folded 9.5px-shift job's corner that #549 left for Kunal's word): switching the engine line on and off moves nothing on the board, which stays the full 360px wide, and leaving analysis turns the line off. Measured at #553: since batch 13's short-upright layout the trade is gone (360 wide at top 64 both ways). Graded by gate 209 (TC-R333..334) at 360x640. The rest of the job is held by gate 20 TC-R71 (exit and re-entry at se, kunal761 and the main walk) and gate 22 TC-R116 (the toggle at se, short375, w375h667, kunal761). NOT COVERED: Kunal's look; landscape.

breaks.name: leaving-analysis-keeps-the-engine-line
breaks.why: _engRestore forgets the saved switch without putting it back, so the engine line analysis turned on stays on after Exit analysis - the job's defect
